rows.grounds: absolutive of knowing; indicates prior understanding
compound expressing source of instruction from the guru
object of knowing; totality of what is taught
fused sandhi form containing optative verb and instrumental noun
locative indicating the locus or recipient of worship

items.question: What knowledge and procedure are required for proper worship in Śiva?
premises: Complete knowledge must be obtained from the guru's mouth
Worship must be performed according to prescribed method
The prescribed worship is directed toward Śiva
items.inference: Therefore, proper worship in Śiva requires learning everything from the guru and performing the rite according to rule
uncertainties: The repetition of vidhinā across tokens 4 and 5 may be emphatic or textual
items.plain_english: Having learned everything from the mouth of the guru, one should worship in Śiva according to the prescribed method.
